english.note: Use this for someone’s general likes or personal tastes, especially in more neutral or formal wording.

examples.english: My preference is pretty simple: I listen to classical music whenever I have time.
examples.traditional: 我嘅喜好比較簡單，得閒就聽古典音樂。
